master:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a MASTER REFERENCE portrait for a modular raster visual-novel face system. Input image is style reference only: retain angular painterly planes, thin expressive ink contour, autumn illustration feeling, not the pose or outfit.
Output one square 1024x1024 PNG with genuinely transparent alpha background (no checkerboard drawn). A single mature androgynous adult head, ears and neck, NO clothes or shoulders. Strict straight-on orthographic frontal portrait, exact bilateral landmark alignment, eyes looking at camera, no head tilt, no three-quarter rotation. Neutral mouth. No facial hair, no jewelry.
Precise registration: face vertical center x512. Bald skull top y155, temples x300 and724 at y390; chin center (512,770). Eye centers (418,460) and (606,460); brows centered y411; nose bridge starts (512,445), nose tip (512,572), nose base y594; mouth center (512,662), mouth width124; ears centers (292,490) and (732,490); neck centered512 from y720 to y970, neck width220. Keep entire head in bounds. No hair on this master so all skull landmarks are visible.
Warm light neutral tan skin. Strong angular cheekbones, nose, jaw and neck shadow planes. Believable adult proportions, moderately narrow eyes, editorial concept-art attractive face, mature simplified anatomy. Painterly gouache blocks and subtle brush grain, sharp graphic cel shading, slightly anime inspired but not generic anime. Fixed lighting from upper image-left, right cheek and right neck in warm deep brown shadow. Avoid photorealism, vector artwork, smooth airbrush, 3D appearance, huge anime eyes. No text, guides, watermark or scenery. This master will only be an authoring reference; separate painted parts will be derived from it.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the MASTER STYLE AND LANDMARK REFERENCE for modular painted portrait assets. Generate ONE isolated modular PART on a genuinely transparent PNG alpha background. Keep original angular painted gouache texture, ink contours, adult mature proportions, upper image-left lighting and warm tan face palette. Straight frontal orientation, no tilt, no rotation. Match reference exactly; other facial features must be removed to transparency. Never paint checkerboard or a backdrop. 1024x1024 square canvas; retain original registration and relative scale as closely as possible. No labels, no text, no guides.
